topic: The deleted scene that would have completely changed the ending everyone loves
hook: The deleted scene would have ruined the ending everyone loves.
script: The deleted scene would have ruined the ending everyone loves. In Pretty Woman, the original ending had Edward abandoning Vivian. She was left on the street. No romance. No rescue. Studio executives forced a rewrite after test screenings caused audience walkouts. The new happy ending made the film a billion-dollar classic. The original version, deemed too realistic, was shelved. One test screening changed Hollywood's most beloved romance. Follow for deleted scenes that would have broken cinema.
